scope: Manifest-verified macOS independent libcoap UDP, PSK and PKI interoperability plus same-stack OSCORE sessions through the Mix-built native helper, the WCO-C09 lifecycle stress lane for all four transports and native-v1 corpus cases through the same helper, with ExUnit-owned peers and bounded cleanup

source_identity.kind: aggregate source SHA-256 from sorted relative paths and bytes; no source commit association asserted

cleanup.assertion_source: interop peer owners plus build-command process-group cleanup

stack_labels.test/interop/oscore_test.exs: same-stack libcoap OSCORE peer and Mix-built native helper
stack_labels.test/software/lifecycle_stress_test.exs: independent libcoap UDP, PSK and PKI peers plus the same-stack OSCORE peer, one case per transport and phase group, with an ExUnit raw UDP fault peer
stack_labels.test/software/native_corpus_test.exs: Mix-built native helper against a test-owned UDP socket and an ExUnit-owned RFC 8613 endpoint independent of libcoap
stack_labels.test/software/native_saturation_test.exs: Mix-built native helper behind the public native owner against an ExUnit-owned RFC 8613 endpoint independent of libcoap

resource_trends.kind: BEAM :erlang.memory(:total) bytes and helper RSS KiB sampled every 100 of 1000 sequential operations; reported, not asserted

assertions: The task verifies an existing completed software-build manifest and never builds a missing workspace
The checked-in native guardian bounds the exact tagged ExUnit command to 300 seconds, 16 MiB of output and five seconds of process-group cleanup
Each UDP, PSK, PKI and OSCORE test owns and closes its libcoap peer, selected adjacent ports and credential workspace
Fifteen independent unary, Block1/Block2, Observe, Runtime, authentication, certificate and DTLS-record cases pass with seed zero
Twelve same-stack OSCORE cases pass through the manifest-verified Mix-built helper and the public native owner
Relayed OSCORE-optioned and plaintext responses with unused tokens cannot end the active protected GET
A relayed malformed datagram carrying the request MID and token cannot end the active protected GET
A captured authenticated notification delivered three more times yields no second value; delivered again after a newer notification it yields none, and the next change is delivered
An unprotected 2.05 with the observation token and a tag-altered genuine notification do not cancel the observation; the next change is delivered
After receiver death every confirmable peer message is acknowledged or reset with its message ID before the helper exits

Protected GET/PUT/POST/DELETE, a negative status as details.code, a 43,500-byte echoed body and discovery succeed before a graceful close that releases the helper and makes the context identity require fresh keying
A mismatched master secret returns security_handshake_failed with effect none, terminates the generation within 1100 ms and never yields an application value
A 1 MiB protected Block1 upload and Block2 download complete inside one 60000 ms interaction deadline

Protected Observe delivers inline and 42,000-byte streamed changes made by a second UDP client, rejects ordinary requests while active and cancels idempotently; the peer records exactly one created and one removed subscription
Receiver death terminates the native owner within 1100 ms, reaps the helper and removes the peer observer
Owner death while a protected request is pending terminates the native owner within 1100 ms, reaps the helper and returns effect none to the caller
A real ConsumedThing readproperty call selects the coap_oscore profile, dispatches through the production helper and decodes the protected JSON value
For UDP, DTLS PSK, DTLS PKI and OSCORE, 1000 sequential PUT/GET operations return the exact latest value on one session
Thirty-two concurrent callers each receive the representation of their own resource
With the owner suspended, 96 callers produce exactly 64 successful responses and 32 busy failures with effect none

One hundred open/close cycles, 100 Observe/cancel cycles with a fresh change each and 100 receiver-death cycles return owner ports and processes to baseline within 1000 ms; peer debug records count one created and one removed subscription per cycle; each OSCORE helper process is gone
A suspended receiver with max_queue_length 2 ends the observation with one receiver_overflow terminal error and no more than two delivered values

A 3-second peer delay ends a 1500 ms operation with timeout and effect none; a raw UDP fault peer ends UDP and OSCORE requests with timeout and DTLS connects with an error of effect none; a closed peer ends a request with timeout or connection_closed; every case returns resources to baseline
The passing result records zero retained command groups, peer processes, UDP ports and session/context/subscription/store locks
The tracked first-party source and packaged test harness contain no Python

Five native-v1 observe commands with an absent, null, 0, "true" or {} renew close the helper generation with a nonzero exit, no reply and no datagram to the open peer, while renew false sends the protected registration
A closed OSCORE context reopened in a second helper generation returns fresh_context_required, leaves the registry bytes unchanged and sends no datagram

Against an ExUnit-owned RFC 8613 endpoint independent of libcoap, native-v1 F21 establishes a protected observation whose report carries Observe 9 after the credit reply, F22 ignores a notification protected for the registration during cancellation and confirms the cancel with result null, and F23 returns invalid_observation_response for a registration answered without Observe

Native-v1 F05 ends an Event subscription with overlapping_event_report after eight credited reports and one pending report, F09 grants no report for replayed or regressing credit and keeps report 13 queued until fresh credit, and F24 emits one observation_failed terminal for two authenticated 4.04 notifications

A suspended native owner holds at most eight report frames and one in-flight credit reply in its mailbox, still receives a terminal through the reserved control slot with the report window full, and a killed suspended owner leaves the helper to cancel the observation and exit within 1100 ms
unaccepted: Owner loss during pending Observe registration, renewal or cancellation, and live replay-window injection through the software run
Actual BEAM Port-mailbox sampling and reserved-control delivery with both channels saturated
The complete native-v1 corpus through the production helper
A Linux AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer software-run lane
The Elixir 1.18.4 / OTP 27.3.4.15 lane and complete committed-source/package matrix
